Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem document. This is the entry point's default error shape, which a host-supplied ErrorResponder may replace.

detail.description: A longer explanation of this occurrence, present only when the answering module has one to give. It may be a sentence rendered in the request language or a language-neutral token such as "forbidden", so clients must not parse it.

instance.description: A URI identifying this occurrence; absent when there is none to give.

status.description: The HTTP status code the response is written with, repeated from the status line.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the standard English status text for the status code.

type.description: The machine-readable code identifying the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the RFC 9457 default about:blank; codes this platform defines are URNs of the form urn:speed:<capability>:<code>.

TenantAdminTenant.description: One tenant as the management routes render it: the identifier, the alias, the organization profile, the owner account, the state, the creation time and who disabled it while it is disabled.

alias.description: The alias the request surface addresses the tenant by.

contactEmail.description: The organization's contact address. Empty when its profile names none. It is the organization's address, not a login identity.

createdAt.description: When the tenant was registered, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

description.description: The organization's description. Empty when its profile names none.

disabledBy.description: Who disabled the tenant: operator through a status change, or account through the account's own state. Present only while the state is disabled.

displayName.description: The organization's display name. Empty when its profile names none; a surface falls back to the alias then.

id.description: The tenant's identifier, the natural key the roster keys the row by.

ownerAccount.description: The account that owns the organization, from the roster row's owner column. Empty for a tenant that carries no owner, such as the platform's own tenant. This is a platform-domain detail; no member-facing view carries it.

status.description: The tenant's state: active is served, disabled is not and may be served again, deleted is a tombstone that is never served again.

website.description: The organization's absolute http or https address. Empty when its profile names none.

account.description: The account identifier of the active member that becomes the organization's owner.

contact_email.description: The organization's contact address, one bare email address of at most 254 bytes. Empty clears it.

description.description: A longer account of the organization, at most 500 runes. Empty clears it.

display_name.description: The organization's display name, at most 100 runes. Empty clears it; a surface then falls back to the alias.

website.description: The organization's absolute http or https address, at most 2048 bytes, with a host and no userinfo. Empty clears it.

TenantAdminTenantRegistration.description: The identifier, alias and optional profile of a tenant to register. The state is not part of it, because a registered tenant starts active.

alias.description: The alias to give the tenant; the roster refuses one another tenant already holds.

contact_email.description: The organization's contact address, one bare email address of at most 254 bytes.

description.description: A longer account of the organization, at most 500 runes.

display_name.description: The organization's display name, at most 100 runes. Empty when the registration names none.

id.description: The identifier to register; the roster refuses one it already holds.

website.description: The organization's absolute http or https address, at most 2048 bytes, with a host and no userinfo.

get.description: Reads every tenant in the roster, ordered by identifier. The roster is the set of tenants this deployment serves and the read is not paged, so the answer always carries the whole list. It is a platform-domain read: the caller needs tenant.read in the platform domain, and no cross-tenant context or permission is involved. Reads write no audit row.

schema.description: The whole roster in one answer, because the listing is not paged.

tenants.description: Every tenant the roster holds, ordered by identifier.

200.description: Every tenant, in the roster's order by identifier

403.description: The caller holds no tenant.read in the platform domain

get.summary: List every tenant the roster holds

post.description: Registers a tenant the roster does not hold yet, together with its first tenant-admin, which is the acting account. The body gives the identifier, the alias and optionally the profile's four descriptive fields; the new tenant starts active. Registration never overwrites: an identifier or an alias already taken is answered 409 and nothing is written. A mandatory audit row must land before the provisioner is called; if it cannot, the registration does not run and the request is answered 503.

requestBody.description: The registration: the identifier to insert, the alias the request surface will address the tenant by, and the optional profile fields. The state is not part of it, because a registered tenant starts active.

schema.description: The tenant as registered, in the same view the read routes render.

tenant.description: The registered tenant, its state active.

400.description: The identifier is outside the identifier domain, or the alias is outside the slug domain

403.description: The caller holds no tenant.manage in the platform domain, or the caller has not proved an email address (contact-required)

409.description: The identifier or the alias is already taken

413.description: The request body is over the endpoint's limit

delete.description: Deletes one tenant platform staff names. The write is a tombstone: the identifier and the alias stay and are never reusable, and the organization's memberships, bindings, roles and grants are removed in the same transaction. Other modules' tenant data is cleaned under the tombstone and is not part of this write. A mandatory audit row lands before the write; if it cannot, nothing is written and the request is answered 503. A tombstone is a 409: deletion is terminal. An organization's owner reaches the tenant surface, not this route.

parameters.description: The tenant's identifier, the natural key the roster keys a tenant by: non-empty and free of whitespace and control characters.
parameters.name: tenant

400.description: The identifier is outside the identifier domain

403.description: The caller holds no tenant.manage in the platform domain, the caller has not proved an email address (contact-required), or the tenant is protected (urn:speed:tenant:protected)

get.description: Reads one tenant by its identifier, the natural key the roster keys a row by, so no opaque row identifier appears in a path. An identifier the roster does not hold is a 404. Reads write no audit row.

parameters.description: The tenant's identifier, the natural key the roster keys a tenant by: non-empty and free of whitespace and control characters.
parameters.name: tenant

tenant.description: The tenant, with its identifier, alias, owner account and state.

403.description: The caller holds no tenant.read in the platform domain

get.summary: Read one tenant the roster holds

put.description: Hands one tenant's ownership to an active member. The target must already be an active member of the organization; the transfer grants it tenant-admin if it does not hold it, and the previous owner loses every binding in the organization and is removed from it. The transfer and those writes are one transaction. A mandatory audit row lands before the write; if it cannot, nothing is written and the request is answered 503.

parameters.description: The tenant's identifier, the natural key the roster keys a tenant by: non-empty and free of whitespace and control characters.
parameters.name: tenant

requestBody.description: The account identifier of the active member that becomes the owner.

400.description: The identifier is outside the identifier domain, the request body is not one JSON object, or the account member is absent

403.description: The caller holds no tenant.manage in the platform domain, or the caller has not proved an email address (contact-required)

409.description: The target is not an active member of the organization, the target's account is not active, or the tenant is a tombstone

413.description: The request body is over the endpoint's limit

patch.description: Writes one tenant's organization profile and nothing else: the display name, description, contact email and website. The identifier, alias, state and creation time are not written, so a profile update cannot undo a disable or a deletion another path committed. The body carries all four fields; an empty value clears the stored one. A profile outside the stated bounds is a 400, an unknown tenant a 404, and a tombstone a 409. A mandatory audit row lands before the roster write, with surface=platform in its detail; if it cannot, nothing is written and the request is answered 503.

parameters.description: The tenant's identifier, the natural key the roster keys a tenant by: non-empty and free of whitespace and control characters.
parameters.name: tenant

requestBody.description: The four descriptive fields, all of them present. An empty value clears the stored one.

tenant.description: The tenant, with its identifier, alias, owner account and state.

200.description: The tenant with the profile as written

400.description: The identifier is outside the identifier domain, the request body is not one JSON object, a member is absent, or the profile is outside the stated bounds

403.description: The caller holds no tenant.manage in the platform domain, or the caller has not proved an email address (contact-required)

409.description: The tenant is a tombstone; a deleted tenant's profile is terminal

413.description: The request body is over the endpoint's limit

post.description: Changes one tenant's state, which is one of the closed set active and disabled. This surface does not write the deleted state: deletion is the roster's terminal marker, written by the host that winds an account up, and the deleted tenant is rendered read-only here. When the write disables the tenant, before the audit the route asks the host's write guard whether the tenant refuses the write: a protected tenant answers 403 with the type urn:speed:tenant:protected and nothing is written. An identifier the roster does not hold is a 404; a tenant the roster holds as a tombstone is a 409, because deletion is terminal and no status change revives it. A mandatory audit row lands before the write; if it cannot, the state is unchanged and the request is answered 503.

parameters.description: The tenant's identifier, the natural key the roster keys a tenant by: non-empty and free of whitespace and control characters.
parameters.name: tenant

status.description: active serves the tenant; disabled stops serving it.

requestBody.description: The target state, one of the closed set active and disabled.

400.description: The identifier is outside the identifier domain or the status is outside the closed set active/disabled

403.description: The caller holds no tenant.manage in the platform domain, the caller has not proved an email address (contact-required), or the tenant is protected against disabling (urn:speed:tenant:protected)

409.description: The tenant is a tombstone; deletion is terminal

413.description: The request body is over the endpoint's limit
